data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 高塔里的绒线手套
data.description: 高塔窗边，艾尔菲利亚穿冰蓝高领针织长裙，将一副新织的白手套摆在膝上。她戴好一只后屈伸手指检查尺寸，望着另一只空手套轻轻出神，窗外雪光柔和地落在脸上。
data.action: 戴好一只手套屈伸手指，看着膝上另一只短暂出神。
data.promptProse: At the snowy tower window, Elfaria Alvis Serfort arranges newly knitted white gloves on her lap, then puts one on and flexes her fingers to check the fit. Her ice-blue high-neck maxi dress and white wool capelet remain cozy as she studies the other empty glove. The medium portrait includes the window ledge and blue hair beside her knees. Soft snow-reflected light reveals glove stitches and her quiet face, with gentle fabric shadows beneath the resting hand.
